```{r}
#| echo: false

get_dailycounts <- function(data, data_temp) {

    data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      dateonly = as.Date(claim_date)
    )
  
  # Merge with temperature
  data_temp <- data_temp %>%
    left_join(data, by = "dateonly")
  
  # daily counts
  data_counts <- data_temp %>%
    group_by(dateonly) %>%
    summarise(
      case  = sum(case, na.rm = TRUE),
      tmax  = mean(temp.max,  na.rm = TRUE),
      tmean = mean(temp.mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      tmin  = mean(temp.min,  na.rm = TRUE),
      himean = mean(hi.mean,  na.rm = TRUE),
      himax  = mean(hi.max,   na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      strata = factor(glue("{year(dateonly)}:{month(dateonly)}:{wday(dateonly)}"))
    )
  
  return(data_counts)
}

ac_counts=get_dailycounts(ed_postpartum, daily.temp.all) #all cause
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

#function to get qaic
fqaic <- function(model) {
  loglik <- sum(dpois(model$y,model$fitted.values,log=TRUE))
  phi <- summary(model)$dispersion
  qaic <- -2*loglik + 2*summary(model)$df[3]*phi
  return(qaic)
}

# function for dlnms 
run_cts <- function(data=counts,
                     temp=counts$tmin,
                     knots=c(0.50,0.90), plot_temp, main_title, outcome
) {
  
  perc <- quantile(temp,probs=c(0.90,0.95,0.99))
  exp_knots <- quantile(temp,probs=knots, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  #cross basis 
  cb <- crossbasis(temp,
                   lag=7,
                   argvar=list(fun = "ns", 
                               knots = exp_knots),
                   arglag = list(fun = "ns", 
                                 knots = logknots(7, 1)))
  
  
model <- gnm(case ~ cb, eliminate = (strata),  family = quasipoisson, data = data)


# reference values
# median
cp_median <- crosspred(cb, model,
                        cen = median(temp),
                        at = seq(min(temp, na.rm = TRUE),
                                 max(temp, na.rm = TRUE),
                                 length = 100))

# mmt
  mmt <- cp_median$predvar[which.min(cp_median$allRRfit)]
  
# predict at both
  cp_refs <- list(
    median = crosspred(cb, model, cen = median(temp, na.rm = TRUE), at = perc),
    mmt    = crosspred(cb, model, cen = mmt,                     at = perc)
  )
cp_mmt <- crosspred(cb, model,
                      cen=mmt,
                      at=seq(min(temp, na.rm=TRUE),
                             max(temp, na.rm=TRUE),
                             length=100))

#predictions at 90-99th pctls
cp_perc_median <- crosspred(cb, model, cen=median(temp, na.rm = TRUE), at=perc)
cp_perc_mmt    <- crosspred(cb, model, cen=mmt,at=perc)

#png(filename=plot_name, width = 1200, height = 800, res = 150) 
  par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2) + 0.1, oma = c(0, 0, 3, 0))  # oma[3] = 7

## Exposure-heartonse curve
  ## Reference=median temp for plots

plot(cp_median, "overall",
     col = 1,
     ylab = "RR",
     xlab = paste0((plot_temp), " (°F)"),
     axes = TRUE,
     lwd = 1.5,
     log = "y",
     main = "Cumulative Effect Across Lag Days", cex.main = 0.7)
abline(v = perc, col = "red", lty = 2)
mtext(paste0("Ref = ", round(median(temp), 1), " °F"), cex = 0.6)

## Lagged effect at 99th percentile
plot(cp_perc_median, "slices",
     var = as.numeric(perc["99%"]),
     col = 1,
     ylab = "RR",
     xlab = "Lag (days)",
     lwd = 1.5,
     main = paste0("Lagged Effect at ", ( round(perc["99%"], 1)), " °F"), cex.main = 0.7)
mtext(paste0("Ref = ", round(median(temp), 1), " °F"), cex = 0.6)
  title(main = main_title, outer = TRUE, cex.main = 1, font.main = 2)

  
## Exposure-heartonse curve
## Reference= mmt for plots

# plot(cp_mmt, "overall",
#      col = 1,
#      ylab = "RR",
#      xlab = paste0((plot_temp), " (°F)"),
#      axes = TRUE,
#      lwd = 1.5,
#      log = "y",
#      main = "Cumulative Effect Across Lag Days", cex.main = 0.7)
# abline(v = perc, col = "red", lty = 2)
# mtext(paste0("Ref = ", round(mmt), 1), " °F"), cex = 0.6)
# 
# ## Lagged effect at 99th percentile
# plot(cp_perc_mmt, "slices",
#      var = as.numeric(perc["99%"]),
#      col = 1,
#      ylab = "RR",
#      xlab = "Lag (days)",
#      lwd = 1.5,
#      main = paste0("Lagged Effect at ", ( round(perc["99%"], 1)), " °F"), cex.main = 0.7)
# mtext(paste0("Ref = ", round(mmt), 1), " °F"), cex = 0.6)
#   title(main = main_title, outer = TRUE, cex.main = 1, font.main = 2)
#   
# 

# Save results as a dataframe
 cumulativeRR <- bind_rows(
    lapply(names(cp_refs), function(ref) {
      cp <- cp_refs[[ref]]
      data.frame(
        Outcome      = outcome,
        TempVar      = plot_temp,
        Reference    = ref,
        ReferenceTemp = ifelse(ref == "median",
                               round(median(temp, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
                               round(mmt, 2)),
        Knots        = paste0("(", paste(round(knots, 2), collapse = ", "), ")"),
        Temperature  = round(as.numeric(perc), 2),
        Percentile   = names(perc),
        QAIC         = fqaic(model),
        RR           = round(cp$allRRfit, 2),
        LowerCI      = round(cp$allRRlow, 2),
        UpperCI      = round(cp$allRRhigh, 2)
      )
    })
  )

  return(cumulativeRR)
}
```

```{r}
outcome_list <- list(
  list(label = "All-Cause:Live+SB",            data = ac_counts),
  list(label = "All-Cause:Live",               data = ac_counts_live),
  list(label = "All-Cause:PP only",            data = ac_counts_pp),
  list(label = "Mental Health:Live+SB",        data = mental_counts),
  list(label = "Mental Health:Live",           data = mental_counts_live),
  list(label = "Obstetric:Live+SB",            data = obst_counts),
  list(label = "Obstetric:Live",               data = obst_counts_live),
  list(label = "Injury:Live+SB",               data = injury_counts),
  list(label = "Injury:Live",                  data = injury_counts_live)
)

# temp variables
temp_list <- list(
  list(var = "tmin",   label = "Minimum Temperature"),
  list(var = "tmean",  label = "Average Temperature"),
  list(var = "tmax",   label = "Maximum Temperature"),
  list(var = "himean", label = "Average Heat Index")
)

# loop through all models
all_results <- list()

for (o in outcome_list) {
  for (t in temp_list) {
    result <- run_cts(
      data       = o$data,
      temp       = o$data[[t$var]],
      knots      = c(0.50, 0.90),
      plot_temp  = t$label,
      main_title = o$label,
      outcome    = o$label
    )
    all_results[[length(all_results) + 1]] <- result
  }
}

# save
all_results <- bind_rows(all_results)
write.csv(all_results, file=("Y:/patels/Output/all_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
